name: nft-accept-then-drop
description: accept precedes drop, so first-match wins and the peer stays reachable
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop
